product.toshiba-t5200.summary: A 20 MHz 386DX transportable with VGA graphics and a gas-plasma display.
product.toshiba-t5200.history: The T5200 brought a desktop-class 32-bit 80386DX, external cache and VGA graphics to Toshiba's transportable T-series. Its integrated gas-plasma screen and mains-powered 8.5 kg chassis made it movable rather than truly mobile. The T5200/100 and /200 paired the same architecture with larger Conner IDE disks; the colour-screen T5200C is not represented by this entry.
product.toshiba-t5200.warning: EXPERIMENTAL: Award V1.30 boots Toshiba MS-DOS 3.30 from validated 720 KB and 1.44 MB floppy paths, and all selectable memory sizes pass TEST3. Toshiba gate-array timing, internal plasma selection, external-floppy routing and Conner hard disks remain incomplete.
product.toshiba-t5200.creation.note: Default: 2 MB, Award V1.30 and one 1.44 MB A: drive. Local system and VGA ROMs are required; DOS and disks are not distributed. No hard disk is created because the documented Conner models have not yet been validated. The internal display currently uses a VGA approximation rather than the gas-plasma panel.
product.toshiba-t5200.technical.market: A high-end transportable business computer combining a 20 MHz 386DX with an integrated display and desktop expansion.
product.toshiba-t5200.technical.commerci: T5200 with 40 MB, T5200/100 with 100 MB and T5200/200 with 200 MB IDE storage. T5200C used a colour STN LCD and is outside this platform.
product.toshiba-t5200.technical.memory: 2 MB onboard, expandable to 14 MB. Selectable 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 and 14 MB populations report the expected totals and pass TEST3. The firmware-facing EMS selector model is functional but its physical gate-array ownership and timing are unknown.
product.toshiba-t5200.technical.video: Toshiba OEM Paradise PVGA1 with 256 KB VRAM and a 32 KB graphics BIOS. External VGA output works through the existing PVGA1A model; the internal 11.5-inch gas-plasma rendering and selection are not yet modeled.
product.toshiba-t5200.technical.storage: One internal 3.5-inch drive supports 720 KB and 1.44 MB media; both boot/read paths and 720 KB write persistence and protection are validated. The model initializes IDE, but documented Conner geometries and firmware compatibility remain unvalidated.
product.toshiba-t5200.technical.firmware: Award V1.30 system BIOS (128 KB) with the matching Toshiba 1988 VGA BIOS (24 KB declared image). Both local ROMs are required.
product.toshiba-t5200.technical.validati: Toshiba MS-DOS 3.30 boots from 720 KB and 1.44 MB media. TEST3 identifies the T5200 and passes memory at every selectable size. EMS selectors pass a direct guest probe. Cache control, Toshiba integration and VGA are deliberately narrow approximations; this is functional validation, not cycle accuracy.
